The project used one flat file in which every trip row carries its household and person fields (household, person, trip and vehicle tables joined): RTS_raw_flat_data.csv, with the codebook RTS_codebook_data_dictionary.xlsx (sheets Household, Person, Trip, Vehicle). The two cleaned files rts_trips_clean.csv (163,290 trips, deduplicated) and rts_tours.csv (57,627 home-based tours) were made by 01_clean_rts.py of the tour-based MITO project; that script is not on this machine, so these two files are shipped and cannot be rebuilt here. data_sources.name: Maryland Statewide Transportation Model (MSTM) 2016 skims, 1,588 SMZ/RMZ zones
data_sources.provider: Maryland Department of Transportation (MDOT SHA), via the project's MAST Maryland set-up (ABIT/input/mito_los/skims)
data_sources.url: https://www.roads.maryland.gov/ (verify: MSTM data are provided by MDOT on request; no download page is documented)
data_sources.how: Obtain the MSTM 2016 skims in OMX format (matrix mat1, lookups origins / destinations): traveltime_auto.omx (AM-peak car time, min), distance_auto.omx (car distance, m), bus_tt.omx (bus time, min; 1000 = no path, 5 intrazonal), rail_tt00.omx (rail time, min; 0 = no rail path). convert_mstm_skims.py turns them into the csv.gz files the models read.

check.basis: full estimation half, all 366 records (full-precision coefficients -1640.9099; hold-out half -1874.0288)

notes: Steps 1-2 need the project Python with numpy, pandas, pyarrow and torch (python3); the Biogeme venv has no torch. The data they write is already in input/data.
Full choice set of 1,588 zones, no sampling of alternatives.

Destination mixture: the survey gives the destination census tract; the likelihood sums b_k exp(V) over the zones k overlapping the tract (b_k = overlap area / zone area) and divides by the sum of exp(V) over all zones. One home configuration per record (weight 1).
Attraction: one variable, B_ln_office_jobs ln(1 + office jobs); no further size components. No bounds.
The hold-out half was also used in the specification search; its log-likelihood is not a fully independent test.
The model has 1,588 utilities per record; use --evaluate (eager, small memory) for checks.
Estimation time: see model/README.md (a test run did not finish compiling in 56 min on this machine under memory pressure).

Shared preparation steps (cwd ../00_shared_prep/code) write to 00_shared_data/rebuilt/ and never overwrite the provided files; compare with check_against_provided.py (step S19) and, to use your rebuilt files, copy them over the provided paths in 00_shared_data before the model's own preparation steps.
